title: CRIC Deployment, Versioning and Release Specification
summary: Defines how CRIC components are packaged, versioned, deployed and released while preserving compatibility across the multi-repository ecosystem.
notes: No frontmatter, no ADR/PRD path convention (path is engineering/, not spec/). Dominant signals are technical contracts: release-manifest YAML schema, version-dimension definitions, compatibility matrix, migration and container-image requirements, offline bundle layout -> SPEC. A trailing 'v0.1 Acceptance Criteria' section is a PRD signal but is a single subordinate section; SPEC outranks PRD under the ambiguity rule. Also 'Version Dimensions' and 'Semantic Versioning' read as settled decisions but there is no Status field, no Context/Consequences structure and no trade-off analysis, so not ADR. Filename disambiguator: no Bash tool available to compute the SHA-256 path hash, so a path-derived suffix (docs-CRIC-PRD-v0-1-engineering) was used instead of a fabricated hex hash; the basename is unique in this doc set so no sibling collision.
